claim: target-domain-free transfer of the completion module: trained and selected on KITTI-360 alone, evaluated on untouched SemanticKITTI and Occ3D without adaptation. NOT whole-system zero-shot: the frozen foundation models (LingBot-Map, MoGe-2, Trident-H) have not had their training provenance audited, and LingBot-Map's published mixture includes KITTI-360.
changes: CompletionUNet convolutions use padding_mode='replicate'; zero padding manufactured observed=0 AND unobserved=0 at the array boundary, a state absent from training, which leaked inward and flooded the grid ceiling.

gate8c1/rawtarget.py marks open sky FREE instead of UNKNOWN: in a column whose LiDAR returns reached a surface, voxels more than SKY_MARGIN_VOX above the topmost return are not occluded, merely above the sensor's top ring. Leaving them UNKNOWN dropped them from the loss and left the ceiling unsupervised (1.12% of the top layer supervised; now 21.9%).
Retrained from scratch on the rebuilt KITTI-360 supervision; checkpoint and thresholds re-selected by the gate's own rule on drive 0006 only.

The sky rule now takes the MAXIMUM column top over a 15x15 window, so a column with no LiDAR return of its own -- 43% of the grid -- inherits a roof height from its neighbours instead of staying unsupervised. A window with no return frees nothing.

rule.checkpoint: highest full-grid occupancy AP on KITTI-360 drive 0006
rule.occupancy_threshold: final-logit threshold maximising full-grid IoU on drive 0006
rule.semantic_threshold: maximises coverage x agreement with the frozen teacher on voxels where both halves of the future window agree; no human semantic label
rule.forbidden: SemanticKITTI and Occ3D/nuScenes are not read

selection.note: selection ran inside a file-access audit; opening a SemanticKITTI / Occ3D / SSCBench-label path would have raised
